question: Project 44 / H5-A-GEOM-HS-NOMINAL is in author-decided HOLD (H8 option A, 2026-11-16). Given that RUN-002 already shows the DC-demeaned, amplitude-normalised residual is not better than a 23-dim FSR flat/saturation shortcut on DEV, does any further read of held-out data (VAL, SEALED) still have information value for the single CLM-001 DEV_ONLY conditional negative claim, or is the only honest next step a zero-fit re-verification of the existing Run?

scope.dataset: D1 Zenodo 20843033 v1, DEV folds only
scope.outcome: balanced-accuracy gap vs FSR shortcut after DC and amplitude removal

probes.observable: per-fold balanced accuracy recomputed from stored RUN-002 predictions, reported as max abs deviation from the stored metrics.json values
probes.comparison_reference: stored RUN-002 metrics.json for the same 26 folds and 18 arms

probes.observable: balanced-accuracy gap between the DC-and-amplitude-removed arm and the FSR shortcut arm, evaluated only on the reserved VAL folds
probes.comparison_reference: 23-dim FSR flat/saturation shortcut on the same VAL folds, frozen hyperparameters, zero model selection

probes.observable: sealed holdout balanced accuracy of the frozen 18-arm design, used once after VAL, with no re-tuning and no model selection
probes.comparison_reference: the frozen VAL-selected arm versus the FSR shortcut arm on the same sealed holdout
